EC1: History of other significant skin disease [OR], or skin manifestations [AND] of allergic illness [OR] or other dermatologic condition, [NOT] except chronic moderate [OR] or severe atopic dermatitis, that would interfere with the trial assessments or compromise the patient's safety according to the opinion of the Investigator
EC2: Present symptoms of other skin diseases, [NOT] except chronic atopic dermatitis, that could disturb the study assessment and evaluation of the skin
EC3: Current use of any active systemic medication [AND] for chronic atopic dermatitis within one month
EC4: Current use of active topical medication [AND] in the planned investigational area for chronic atopic dermatitis within two weeks
EC5: History of a sunny holiday [OR], UV-light therapy [OR] or solarium use within one month before beginning of study treatments, or planning such during the study [OR] or within 7 days after the study
EC6: Allergy to cis-UCA [OR], or any constituents of the placebo emulsion cream [OR] or any constituents of Protopic® ointment
EC8: Congenital or acquired immunodeficiency [OR] or ongoing therapy [AND] that cause immunosuppression
EC9: Earlier participation in a clinical study performed with cis-UCA
EC10: Any clinically significant laboratory test result
EC11: Suspected current drug [OR] or alcohol abuse
EC12: Clinically significant illness during the 4 weeks prior to the first dose administration
EC13: Any other condition that in the opinion of the Investigator would interfere with the evaluation of the study results or constitute a health hazard for the patient
EC14: Unwillingness or doubtful capacity to comply with the protocol
EC15: Doubtful availability to complete the study
